BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.

2. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.

3. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Sanitary Appliances.

4. When learning Roof Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Roof Construction.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Roof Construction.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Roof Construction.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Windows.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

8. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.

9. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

11. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.

12. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Doors.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Drainage Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Building Construction Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Construction Hand Power Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Construction Plant and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.

3. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.

5. C — CPU

6. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.

7. A — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.

9. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.

10. B — Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.

12. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Drainage Systems; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Construction Hand Power Tools; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Construction Plant; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
